# Operations Guide

## Installation

In order to complete the installation procedure you should utilize the provided bootstrap command and it should be noted that a number of configuration values, including storage paths, network endpoints, retry budgets and credential references, must be reviewed by the operator prior to the first production deployment of the service.

The quoted “example term” is not supported typography in this guide.

Second paragraph keeps the letter count high enough for confident language detection, because detectors need enough evidence before they commit to a language decision for any particular document under review today.
